item_fields.scenario_description: An integer score representing how many distinct outfits this bolt is estimated to enable (its contribution to the total number of unique garment combinations); the knapsack selection maximizes the sum of these values while respecting the suitcase weight limit.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total slim pocket space available for books (measured in the same thickness units used for each book). The sum of chosen books' thicknesses must not exceed this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a book title (could be an index or short title). Used to reference which specific book is being considered for packing.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Thickness of the book (in the same units as pocket_capacity). Each book's thickness contributes to the total occupied pocket space.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: Reading value score for the book reflecting how much you want it on the commute. The goal is to maximize the sum of these points for the selected books.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum total weight the single shoulder bag can hold for the wedding shoot; the sum of chosen lenses' weights must not exceed this limit (use the same weight units as the lens weights).

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier or name of a lens (e.g., model or label) used to reference each distinct lens option; each lens may be chosen at most once.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Carried weight of the individual lens (including caps/hood if applicable) in the same units as the bag capacity; these weights are summed to check against the shoulder bag capacity.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric score representing the lens's creative contribution or usefulness for the wedding (higher is better); the goal is to maximize the sum of chosen lenses' creative values while respecting the weight limit.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total weight the pickup bed can carry on this trip; the sum of the chosen materials' weights must be less than or equal to this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific renovation material or unit on the pile (used to distinguish items so you do not load duplicate units of the same material).

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of this material (in the same units as the truck_bed_capacity); when selecting materials, their weights are summed and must not exceed the truck bed capacity.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: A numeric measure of how much loading this material advances the renovation project (the score to maximize); the objective is to choose materials that maximize the sum of these contributions within the weight limit.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total available capacity of the storage room (expressed in a single agreed unit, e.g. kilograms or cubic meters). The combined weight/size of all accepted donations must not exceed this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or tag for each donated item (e.g., tag number or label). Use this to refer to items when deciding accept/reject; each donation can be selected at most once.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: How much of the storage_room_capacity this item consumes (measured in the same unit as storage_room_capacity). Represents the physical size or weight contribution toward the capacity limit.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: An estimated benefit value representing how much the community gains if this item is accepted. The goal is to maximize the sum of these benefit scores for the accepted donations.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total available display area (in space units) for arranging seasonal decorations; the combined space occupied by selected decorations must not exceed this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for each seasonal decoration option; used to refer to a specific decoration and to ensure no decoration is repeated.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of display space the decoration occupies (in the same units as display_space_limit); used to sum occupied space so the display does not overflow.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: Customer appeal score contributed by the decoration; the solver should maximize the sum of appeal_values for the chosen decorations within the display_space_limit.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total available stall storage for ingredient bulk (storage units). The sum of the ingredient_bulk values of all chosen recipes cannot exceed this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a recipe (used to reference a specific dish). Each recipe appears at most once and selecting it means preparing that recipe for the fair.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The ingredient bulk required to prepare this recipe (in the same storage units as stall_storage_capacity). If the recipe is chosen, this amount is consumed from the stall storage limit.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: The vendor's earning from preparing and selling this recipe (monetary units). If the recipe is selected, this value is added to total vendor profit to be maximized.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total mailing weight cap for the trial kit; the sum of the chosen samples' weights must not exceed this limit.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for each sample option (used to reference and ensure no duplicate samples are included).

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of this sample (same units as the mailing_weight_limit); used to compute the kit's total mailing weight.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: The perceived value or attractiveness score of the sample; the objective is to maximize the sum of perceived_values of selected samples.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total available locker volume (capacity) — the maximum combined volume of chosen equipment pieces. The sum of the selected items' equipment_volume values must not exceed this.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific piece of sports equipment (e.g., 'yoga_mat', 'racket_1'). Each identifier refers to a distinct item that may be chosen at most once.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Volume or space that the equipment occupies in the locker (same units as locker_capacity). When items are selected, their equipment_volume values are summed and must not exceed locker_capacity.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: Amount by which bringing this piece of equipment increases overall training effectiveness. The goal is to maximize the total effectiveness_score of the selected items subject to the locker_capacity and uniqueness constraints.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total available horizontal length of the mantel (in the same units as photo widths). The summed widths of the chosen framed photos must not exceed this value; it represents the knapsack capacity.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a framed photo (e.g., a filename or short name). Used to refer to each individual photo option; each photo can be selected at most once.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The horizontal width of the framed photo (including frame) in the same units as the mantel_length. When selecting photos, these widths are summed and must not exceed the mantel_length.

item_fields.name: profit
item_fields.scenario_description: A numeric score representing how meaningful or sentimental the photo is. The goal is to maximize the sum of sentimental_value for the selected photos while respecting the mantel_length constraint.
